name: 빅맥

referenceVerification.method: Read official Korean menu description and visually inspected the rendered official product photo in the browser.
uncertainties: 공식 설명은 패티 2장과 치즈·양상추·양파·피클·소스를 명시한다. 층 순서는 공식 사진을 관찰했다.
소스 배합·정확한 양과 패티 실측 두께는 공개 사진만으로 확인할 수 없어 시각적 추정이다.

prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: original AI-generated burger cutout for a Korean burger tournament web application.
Primary request: create one photorealistic Korean McDonald's Big Mac burger, informed by the official Korean menu photo visually inspected at https://www.mcdonalds.co.kr/kor/menu/detail/178/3/16. Recreate the recognizable ingredient structure with new photography, not a pasted official photo.
Subject accuracy: EXACTLY TWO thin, browned, flat griddled round beef patties, NOT thick gourmet patties. EXACTLY THREE bread layers: rounded golden sesame-seed top bun, one distinct horizontal lightly toasted middle club bun, and flat bottom bun. Match this visible top-to-bottom stack: sesame crown, upper beef patty, finely shredded iceberg lettuce with tiny diced white onion and green crinkle-cut pickle slices and pale tan Big Mac sauce, middle club bun, lower beef patty, one soft yellow American cheese slice with corners draping, more shredded iceberg/onion/sauce, bottom bun. Compact fast-food proportions, the two thin beef patties and middle bun unmistakable. No tomato, bacon, chicken, fried patty or additional meat.
Style/medium: high-quality realistic studio food product photograph with natural toasted bread, lightly browned beef texture, crisp fresh pale-green lettuce, realistic sauce, consistent with the project's existing clean bright Mom's Touch thigh burger cutout.
Composition: single complete assembled burger centered on a square canvas, nearly straight-on with a very slight three-quarter angle and tiny view of the crown; burger occupies about 85% of width and stays entirely within frame with clean transparent margins.
Lighting: soft bright neutral studio light, crisp ingredient detail, realistic appetizing color, no heavy shadow.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no surface.
Constraints: no text, watermark, logo, packaging, plate, fries, drink, props, hands or extra items. Do not create an exploded view or cut burger. Preserve actual alpha transparency.

validation.visualInspection: 패티 개수·주요 재료·층 순서·로고/텍스트 없음·전체 버거 구도를 검수했다. 배경 후광이나 바닥은 보이지 않는다.
validation.note: AI 재현 이미지이며 실제 상품의 두께·형상·질감과 완전히 동일함을 보장하지 않는다.
